title: ci: establish a product-capable hosted Python under ADR 0032
body:
Access CI on #132 selected CPython 3.12.15 whose actual SQLite was 3.45.1; the unchanged product safety guard correctly refused it before pytest. This PR selects a complete checksum-bound python-build-standalone CPython 3.12.15 distribution (20261021). Both hosted product jobs now load actual SQLite 3.53.1 and pass the original runtime guards plus STRICT/JSON/FTS5/WAL probes.

The interpreter is explicit through locked dev/docs preparation, pytest, offline children and actual direct/sdist artifact venvs. Eight Access runtime receipts retain the same resolved Python binary, digest, SQLite/source ID and compile options, with null loader overrides and built-in _sqlite3. No separate SQLite component is downloaded, built, installed or replaced. Product source, safety predicates, DDL, assertions, original pytest targets and offline protections are unchanged. The independent stdlib-only policy job remains separate.

Stack: #132 at `a022dd3efb9c8116cf9dc0abc13ab1d5bbc88e37` → this PR. Final source HEAD: `f16e5b1713bde9a2f18263a25397c4b450fd5773`, tree `6bfa580baafa9f6a117b7a0b610c4e65cd031b86`. GitHub's test merge has that same tree.

| Final hosted check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| [tests 39799299296](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39799299296) | **success**; policy 0 violations, 31 detector + 4 runtime tests pass; offline development static/smoke checks pass |
| [Access 39799299209](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39799299209) | **failure**, inherited functional failures retained |
| Original source pytest / broad offline cohort | 2,696 / 3,058 passed; each retains 59 failures + 20 setup errors, exit 1, zero skips |
| Bounded I4 / I5 | **217 / 29 passed**, exact JUnit/journal reconciliation |
| Direct and sdist-derived wheels, separately | runtime/file hashes and I2/I3 probes pass; each I4 217 and I5 29 pass; each original Access smoke still fails inherited Transfer refusal |
| Remaining audits | ownership/schema/boundary/registration, docs, formatting and final runtime identity pass; Access acceptance ledger correctly refuses failed-node receipt |

All **79** non-successes match PR #132's frozen execution, including full trace frames and line numbers: **0 added, 0 resolved**. Historical I4 comparison also preserves nodes/phases/refusals/frame paths/functions; its earlier line shifts are already present in #132. Transfer/identification-wire support and I6/I7 work remain unfinished. No expected failure was skipped, xfailed or converted to success.

Final local CI/tool cohort: **289 passed + 57 subtests**, disjoint from the hosted broad cohort. Of 5,742 ordinary nodes, 2,570 remain unexecuted on the host; combining final hosted source with final local tools leaves **2,316 ordinary nodes**, one live and one benchmark unexecuted. Installed copies overlap source coverage. The offline helper ran inventory only; no complete release acceptance is claimed. The tests workflow's normal development mode intentionally executes no pytest/packaging lane.

A new intermediate bootstrap negative-fixture failure was fixed at f16 without changing the real loader guard; final hosted 4 tests pass. Its failed log is preserved. A mutable-input local broad trial is explicitly excluded from final frozen acceptance.

**Independent non-author agent review: PASS**, no unresolved material code findings. Verified no SQLite replacement, unchanged safety/source/targets/assertions, actual installed-venv identities, raw hosted receipts, all 79 failures and omissions.

[Complete execution report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/14b7901c95b01b1ad2fc162f76e0210abc049a96/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/README.md) · [independent review](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/14b7901c95b01b1ad2fc162f76e0210abc049a96/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/independent-review.md) · [machine results](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/14b7901c95b01b1ad2fc162f76e0210abc049a96/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/results.json) · [indexed raw evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/14b7901c95b01b1ad2fc162f76e0210abc049a96/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/artifact-index.json).

Independent archive audit also passed: all 150 outer members and all three inner receipt indices verify; payload SHA-256 `e38171c16b5e58cfa222f281ea87406645ae85876cc05aa9f34f055749a76176`.

Evidence is published on the separate `evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022` branch at `14b7901c95b01b1ad2fc162f76e0210abc049a96`, descended from the final source HEAD; publication is not another test execution. Artifact blob HTTP 403 was handled through indexed job-log receipts, with outer and per-member hashes verified. PR #129–#132, their branches/frozen evidence/reviews and protection settings are untouched. No merge, release or deployment was performed.

### Final independent re-audit — 2026-10-22 UTC

**Completed; source HEAD remains `f16e5b1713bde9a2f18263a25397c4b450fd5773`, tree `6bfa580baafa9f6a117b7a0b610c4e65cd031b86`.** No further source fix/commit was needed. Existing hosted executions were audited again; this is not a new product test run. The append-only evidence supplement is published at `4cd083b0f7295a2bbaa2597ef483af46e77f5463` on the existing evidence branch; original frozen evidence is unchanged.

[Final audit and every job/step conclusion / exit-code evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4cd083b0f7295a2bbaa2597ef483af46e77f5463/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/final-audit/README.md) · [new independent non-implementer review](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4cd083b0f7295a2bbaa2597ef483af46e77f5463/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/final-audit/independent-audit.md) · [machine checks](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4cd083b0f7295a2bbaa2597ef483af46e77f5463/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/final-audit/audit-results.json) · [supplement hashes](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4cd083b0f7295a2bbaa2597ef483af46e77f5463/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022/final-audit/index.json).

- Final Actions outcomes are unchanged: tests **success**; Access **failure**. Explicit nonzero shell exits are **1** in Access steps 7, 8, 10, 12 and 14. The report distinguishes measured log exits, inferred successful-shell 0, and unexposed action/job numerical codes. Ordinary tests CI selected no pytest/packaging lane; Access ran all substantive later lanes.
- Actual product runtime: **Python 3.12.15 / built-in SQLite 3.53.1**, source ID `2026-05-05 10:34:17 c88b22011a54b4f6fbd149e9f8e4de77658ce58143a1af0e3785e4e6475127e9`. Eight runtime receipts and real Access/P1 + STRICT/JSON/FTS5/WAL safety probes pass. ADR 0032 has no recurrence violation.
- All **79** inherited non-successes retain the same nodes, phases, refusal conditions and full recorded frames/line numbers: **0 added / 0 resolved**. Groups: **45 call failures + 20 setup errors** at Transfer fences, **14 call failures** at identification-wire fences. Four subprocess wrapper messages differ only by pytest temporary venv paths and observed repr truncation; unmodified deltas and constrained normalization are retained.
- Both actual wheel installations have **153 source/DDL/JSON file hashes identical to the pinned source**, use the selected Python's SQLite, and retain hash-required offline installation. Each passes safety/runtime, I2/I3 probes, **I4 217 / I5 29**. Each original Access smoke still returns **1 / I2_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED**. Bounded I4/I5 fixtures remove two named I2 fences only in disposable databases; passing them does not establish end-to-end production Transfer.
- A separate non-implementer agent independently checked fresh-log receipt equality, outer150/inner3 indices, frozen456-input sets, exact source JUnit/journal nodes/phases, failure comparison and coverage; **PASS, no unresolved material source finding**. The final supplement/index also passed independent review. New tool-only local recheck: **35 tests pass**, static policy **0 violations**.
- Remaining scope: inherited Transfer and identification-wire work, host-unexecuted **2,570** ordinary nodes; **2,316** ordinary nodes after combining prior final local tools, plus one live and one benchmark node. Full release acceptance remains incomplete.

**I6+ judgment: engineering development may begin** with this qualified environment and explicit inherited-failure baseline, following the current stage dependencies and independent review obligations. This does not establish full product/release acceptance or grant merge permission. No I6 implementation was started, no new PR was created, PR #129–#132 were not changed, and **no merge was performed**.
